scope: real authorized video CDNs, pure file-transfer diagnostics on one macOS egress; not full HLS/DASH/application acceptance

versions.ffprobe: ffprobe version 9.0.2 Copyright (c) 2007-2026 the FFmpeg developers

method.order: five rotating arms; one video at a time
method.reference: one full matched-header transfer and ffprobe per sample, outside speed denominator; warmed CDN/cache conditions
method.timing: external process wall, including startup and final write; complete SHA256 outside timer
method.network: original HTTP/HTTPS URLs and normal video-CDN redirects; per-host fixed public IP snapshot; common benchmark-owned byte relay bound to physical egress; end-to-end TLS, no external proxy; no OS settings changed
method.headers: all timed arms use same explicit UA/platform Referer/resolver headers and identity encoding; automatic/no-Referer/default-header controls separate
method.aria2: split=8, max-connection-per-server=8, min-split-size=1M, no config/netrc, one request attempt
method.rvdown: connections=1/4/8 ceilings; 1MiB minimum piece; one request retry attempt; resource-domain safety restarts remain active
method.httpx: Python httpx 0.28.1 synchronous streaming helper, one GET, 1MiB buffers, no transfer retry; not a separately distributed httpx-fetch executable
method.controls: same headers are explicit caller overrides, not identical built-in wire headers/TLS/protocol; configured segments are not TCP connections
method.limitations: common Python relay may bound throughput or change concurrency costs; CPU/RSS below are child process values excluding that shared relay; one egress, five repetitions, small source set; no independent policy holdout

network_observation.scope: short PID sample, not full-run packet capture

policy_replay.scope: in-sample replay of measured medians; not an implemented or independently validated automatic mode
policy_replay.rule: generic <=32MiB one stream, >32MiB up to8; Bili <=4 one, 4..32 up to4, >32 up to8; observed redirecting Douyin and fast Xigua sources remain one
